units: <cite ref="Yevamot 48b:14">Yeb. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>עיר הסמוכה לס׳</he> a town near the boundary.

<cite ref="Sotah 42a:16">Sot. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>פעמים מדבר עמו אחת בס׳ וכ׳</he> the priest addressed the people twice, once on the border line (before entering the enemy’s land) and once before the battle.

<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 4:5">Tosef. Erub. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 3:5">III</cite>), 5 <he>באו … הסמוכות לס׳</he> if the enemy invades towns near the boundary (of Palestine); Y. ib. IV, 21ᵈ bot.; Bab.
<cite ref="Eruvin 45a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>ובבל כעיר הסמוכה לס׳ וכ׳</he> and Babylonia is (as regards the duty of defence) like a town near the boundary, which was interpreted to mean Neharde‘a.
Num. R. s. 16 מה ראה לישב לו על הס׳ וכ׳ what reason had he (Amalek) to settle on the border, on the way of the entrance of the Israelites into the land?; a. e.—Pi. סְפָרִים, constr. סִפְרֵי.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 2:1:7">Y. Ḥall. II, 58ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ס׳ א״י</he> Palestinian districts, <he>ס׳ חוצה לארץ</he> foreign districts (conquered by Israelites).
